in_arabic.name: Diras
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Writing on palm
in_arabic.long_meaning: Diras هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Arabic word ‘d-r-s’, which means ‘writing on palm’. It is mentioned in a Hadith that the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) used to write duas (supplications) on his hand and teach his companions to do the same. This name therefore carries a spiritual and symbolic meaning, reminding us of the importance of seeking closeness to Allah through remembrance and supplication.
